snippet.title: Yollen - Official Announcement Trailer
snippet.description: You didn’t ask for this life. But you’re going to end his. Check out the Yollen trailer for this upcoming minimalist incremental RPG about revenge, progress, and mastery. Made by solo developer axilirate, this is the first step on the road to Megaloot. Chop, smelt, fight, steal, and build your way toward confronting Yollen - the one who shattered your world. Yollen will be available on PC, and a demo is out now on Steam.
